question_text: You will play a coin game against an opponent. A biased coin will be continually flipped where there is a 2/3 chance of Heads and a 1/3 chance of Tails. If Heads is flipped then you receive $1 from your opponent. If Tails is flipped then you pay $1 to your opponent. You start with $10 and your opponent starts with $20. You keep playing until one of you is bankrupt (= has $0 left); they will be declared the loser, the other will be declared the winner. What is the probability that you win?
